full_prompt_en: This square oil painting shows a woman in a deep red dress standing with her back to the viewer in a sunlit stone opening beside blue water. She is centered between massive warm ochre walls, and her full figure extends from near the top of the archlike gap to the pale paving at the bottom. Her dark shoulder-length hair turns slightly toward the left, revealing only a suggestion of the side of her face. The dress has short sleeves set off the shoulders, a fitted waist marked by a small bright belt, and a loose skirt falling below the knees. Her arms hang at her sides, and narrow high-heeled shoes catch tiny highlights where they touch the ground. Across the water, an industrial-looking shore of low brown buildings and a long suspension bridge is visible through the opening. The bridge stretches horizontally behind her body, its upright tower and slender cables softened by distance. The near foreground is made of broad cream and gray paving strokes with long cool shadows angling from the wall. The stone sides have thick, broken patches of tan, rust, and brown paint; their rough surface contrasts with the smoother blue water and pale sky. Strong daylight enters the gap from beyond, lighting her bare shoulders and portions of the dress while leaving the right wall in deeper shadow. Brush marks remain visible throughout, especially in masonry and ground, so detail resolves into large patches when seen from afar. The composition is quiet and cinematic, using the red figure as a warm vertical accent inside a bright framed view of the water and bridge.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形油画描绘一位身穿深红裙的女子背对观看者，站在蓝色水域旁一处阳光照亮的石墙开口内。她位于厚重的暖赭色墙体之间，完整身影从拱门般缺口的上部延伸到画面下方的浅色铺地。深色齐肩发稍向左转，只隐约显出脸的侧面。裙装有露肩短袖、由小块亮色腰带束起的腰部，以及垂至膝下的宽松裙摆。双臂自然垂在身侧，细高跟鞋在接触地面处映出小小亮点。开口之外隔水可见低矮棕色建筑组成的工业式岸线和一座长悬索桥。桥从她身后水平延伸，竖直桥塔和细缆线因距离而柔化。近前景由宽阔奶油与灰色铺地笔触构成，墙投下的长冷影斜穿地面。两侧石墙有厚重破碎的棕黄、锈红与棕色颜料斑块；其粗糙表面与较平滑的蓝水、浅天形成反差。强烈日光从开口彼端进入，照亮她裸露的双肩和裙上部分区域，而右侧墙面落入更深阴影。各处都留有可见笔痕，尤其石砌体与地面，远看细节汇成大色块。构图安静而有电影感，红色人物作为暖调竖向重音，立于水与桥的明亮框景之中。
style_prompt_en: Impressionistic oil painting uses broken, blocky strokes to suggest material and atmosphere without fully smoothing the surface. Warm ochre, rust, and cream areas frame cooler blue-gray distances; a concentrated red accent gives the middle of the composition weight. Strong daylight creates clear zones of brightness and long cool shadows, while far forms lose detail and soften. Rough textured edges in the near field contrast with quieter horizontal bands beyond. The image is organized through a broad opening, a central vertical rhythm, and expansive lateral depth, producing a warm, cinematic stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 印象式油画用破碎块状笔触暗示材料与空气，而不把表面完全抹平。暖赭、锈红和奶油色区域围住较冷的蓝灰远景；集中的红色重音给构图中央增添分量。强日光形成清楚的亮区和修长冷影，远处形体则失去细节、逐渐变柔。近处粗糙带纹理的边缘与远方安静的水平色带相对。画面由宽阔开口、中央竖向节奏与横向伸展的纵深组织，产生温暖、电影般的静止感。
theme_en: A woman in a red dress facing a waterfront bridge through a stone opening
theme_zh: 红裙女子穿过石墙开口面向水边桥梁
name: Mark Spain
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
